newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Integrated Medical a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Integrated Medical a hold.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it has started coverage of Integrated Medical Resources Inc with a hold "due do unexpected recent revenue weakness."
-- In written research, H&Q noted revenue per patient has been increasing slowly, but "new patient flow has been substantially lower than expected, especially in November."
-- It called early results from a new direct marketing campaign to increase revenues "encouraging".
-- H&Q expects the company to post a loss of $1.01 a share on revenue of $11.1 million in 1996 and a loss of $0.40 a share on revenue of $19.4 million in 1997.
